**Open Design** is an open-source, local-first alternative to Anthropic's "Claude Design"[1][2][3]. It is hosted on GitHub under the **nexu-io/open-design** repository[2][3].

### Key Details
*   **GitHub Repository:** [github.com/nexu-io/open-design](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design)[2]
*   **Core Philosophy:** Unlike Claude Design, which is a closed-source, hosted SaaS product, Open Design is designed to be **local-first** and **agent-agnostic**[1][4][3].
*   **How it Works (BYOK):** It does not bundle its own AI agent[1][5]. Instead, it acts as a "skill bundle" that connects to coding CLI agents already installed on your system[1][4][6]. Supported agents include **Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Qwen, GitHub Copilot CLI,** and others[2][3].
*   **Features:**
    *   **Artifact-First Loop:** Similar to Claude Design, it supports generating web prototypes, slide decks, dashboards, and mobile apps from natural language prompts[1][3][7].
    *   **Extensive Systems:** It ships with numerous composable skills and prebuilt, brand-grade design systems[1][3].
    *   **Export Options:** Supports exports in various formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and ZIP[1][3][7].
    *   **Deployment:** The web interface can be deployed to Vercel, while the daemon runs locally to maintain file-system access and privacy[1][4][5].

### Why it is considered an alternative
The project emerged as a community response to Claude Design, aiming to remove vendor lock-in[3][8]. By using the "Bring Your Own Key" (BYOK) model, users can leverage their existing agent subscriptions and local workflows without having to upload data to a proprietary cloud environment[1][2][8].
